namespaces.name: project
namespaces.summary: `studio.project`: the open project and its metadata (design §4.2, §0.6). Implemented by `createProjectApi(): ProjectApi` in `namespaces/project.ts`.

methods.name: current
methods.summary: The open project, or null when no project is open. Not an undo step.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Every project in the workspace storage. Not an undo step.

methods.name: create
methods.summary: Create a new empty project in workspace storage and open it: it becomes the current project with its empty timeline and its own media library, so media can be imported right away (no `project.open` needed). Not an undo step.
methods.example: const { id } = await studio.project.create({ name: 'Flight', width: 3840, height: 2160, fps: { num: 60000, den: 1001 } })

methods.name: rate
methods.summary: The project frame rate as an exact fraction. Not an undo step.

methods.name: context
methods.summary: The editing context the SDK is working in. Not an undo step.

methods.name: duration
methods.summary: Length of the active timeline in frames. Not an undo step.

methods.name: set
methods.summary: Change the project's canvas size, rate or background. One undo step.

methods.name: save
methods.summary: Write the active timeline to workspace storage. Not an undo step.

methods.name: open
methods.summary: Open a stored project, replacing the editor's timeline, clearing its undo history and loading the project's media library. Not an undo step.

namespaces.name: media
namespaces.summary: `studio.media`: the media library (design §4.2). Implemented by `createMediaApi(): MediaApi` in `namespaces/media.ts`.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Media library items, optionally filtered by kind. Not an undo step.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: One media library item, or null when it does not exist. Not an undo step.

methods.name: import
methods.summary: Import files through their handles. Library state. Not an undo step. In the desktop app a media file can be named by absolute path instead: an array of paths is accepted, and each file is served through the app's own allow-listed media route; a browser has only handles.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Remove items from the library. Library state. Not an undo step.

methods.name: url
methods.summary: A URL the browser can play or decode the media from, or null when the bytes are unavailable. Not an undo step.

namespaces.name: subclips
namespaces.summary: `studio.subclips`: named ranges of library files (design 1.6, D7). Implemented by `createSubclipsApi(): SubclipsApi` in `namespaces/subclips.ts`. Subclips are library state like media: no call here is an undo step, and a clip placed from a subclip is a clip of the file (`clips.add` with the range).

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Subclips in the order they were made, optionally those of one file. Not an undo step.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: One subclip, or null when it does not exist. Not an undo step.

methods.name: create
methods.summary: Cut a named range out of a library file. Library state. Not an undo step. Place it with `clips.add({ mediaId, trackId, from, sourceStart: startFrame, sourceEnd: endFrame })`.
methods.example: const s = studio.subclips.create({ mediaId: 'm-1', startFrame: 90, endFrame: 210, name: 'Gap' })

methods.name: rename
methods.summary: Change a subclip's name. Library state. Not an undo step.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Delete subclips. Clips already placed from them stay: they are clips of the file. A call that names one missing id deletes nothing. Library state. Not an undo step.

namespaces.name: tracks
namespaces.summary: `studio.tracks`: the track stack of the active context (design §4.2). Implemented by `createTracksApi(): TracksApi` in `namespaces/tracks.ts`. Classic `V#`/`A#` names are re-derived from a track's position on every write, exactly as in the app.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Tracks from top to bottom. Not an undo step.

methods.name: add
methods.summary: Add a track at `position` (0 = top). One undo step.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Change a track's name and controls. One undo step.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Delete a track and every clip on it. One undo step.

methods.name: reorder
methods.summary: Set the stack order from an array of track ids, top first. One undo step.

namespaces.name: clips
namespaces.summary: `studio.clips`: the clips of the active context (design §4.2, §4.3). Implemented by `createClipsApi(): ClipsApi` in `namespaces/clips.ts`.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Clips, optionally filtered by track or kind. Not an undo step.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: One clip, or null when it does not exist. Not an undo step.

methods.name: add
methods.summary: Place a media library item on a track. One undo step.
methods.example: const id = studio.clips.add({ mediaId: 'm-1', trackId: 'v1', from: 0, sourceStart: 90, sourceEnd: 210 })

methods.name: addMany
methods.summary: Place several media items in one step. One undo step.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Change a clip's label, gain, fades or transform. One undo step.

methods.name: move
methods.signature: move(id: ClipId, to: Frame, trackId?: TrackId): void
methods.summary: Move a clip to `to`, optionally onto another track. One undo step.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Delete clips, optionally closing the gap. One undo step.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.summary: Copy clips after themselves. One undo step.

methods.name: split
methods.summary: Split a clip at a timeline frame. One undo step.

methods.name: trimStart
methods.summary: Trim a clip's start by `frames`; positive shortens, negative extends. One undo step.

methods.name: trimEnd
methods.summary: Trim a clip's end by `frames`; positive shortens, negative extends. One undo step.

methods.name: setSpeed
methods.summary: Change a clip's playback speed, keeping its source range, and clear any speed curve: a constant speed is the no-curve case. One undo step.

methods.name: getSpeedCurve
methods.summary: A clip's speed curve, or null when it plays at one speed. Not an undo step. Keys are clip-relative frames, like keyframes: frame 0 is the clip's first frame, and the last key sits at the clip's current length.

methods.name: setSpeedCurve
methods.signature: setSpeedCurve(id: ClipId, keys: SpeedKey[] | null): void
methods.summary: Set a clip's speed curve, or remove it with null (the clip keeps playing at the curve's average speed). The shape keeps the clip's source span and takes the length it needs, moving the clips after it. One undo step.
methods.example: studio.clips.setSpeedCurve('c1', [{ frame: 0, speed: 1 }, { frame: 120, speed: 4 }, { frame: 300, speed: 1 }])

methods.name: getMotionBlur
methods.summary: A clip's motion blur settings, or null when it has none (blur off). Not an undo step.

methods.name: setMotionBlur
methods.signature: setMotionBlur(id: ClipId, settings: MotionBlurSettings | null): void
methods.summary: Switch a clip's motion blur on with a shutter angle, or off with null. The blur blends the source frames each output frame covers when the clip plays faster than 1x; with `blendSlowMotion` it also blends the two frames around each slow-motion frame (below 1x, or a 30 fps file in a 60 fps project), so a slow-down plays smoothly instead of repeating frames. One undo step.

methods.name: setSpeedPreset
methods.signature: setSpeedPreset(id: ClipId, preset: SpeedPreset, options?: SpeedPresetOptions): void
methods.summary: Give a clip one of the three ramp presets: ramp in from 1x, ramp out to 1x, or both with a hold at the peak. The shape keeps the clip's source span and takes the length it needs, moving the clips after it. One undo step.

methods.name: speedAt
methods.summary: The speed a clip holds at a timeline frame, in x: the curve's value there, or the clip's constant speed when it has no curve. `frame` is an absolute timeline frame, like `clips.split` and `playback.seek`; the keys a curve carries stay clip-relative. Not an undo step.

methods.name: getColorProfile
methods.summary: A clip's colour profile, or null when it is unset (nothing was answered for it). `none` is an answer: "this file needs no input transform". Not an undo step.

methods.name: setColorProfile
methods.signature: setColorProfile(id: ClipId, profile: ColorProfile | null): void
methods.summary: Set a clip's colour profile: `dlog-m` (DJI D-Log M, the Avata 2's profile), `dlog`, or `none`; null clears the answer. One undo step.

methods.name: getLook
methods.summary: A clip's creative look, or null when it has none. Not an undo step.

methods.name: setLook
methods.signature: setLook(id: ClipId, look: ClipLookRequest | null): void
methods.summary: Apply a look of the looks library to a clip, with a blend (default 1), or remove it with null. Ids come from `looks.list()`, which must have been called once in the session. One undo step.

methods.name: getStabilization
methods.summary: A clip's stored stabilization settings, or null when it was never stabilized. A clip switched off keeps its settings with `enabled: false`. Not an undo step.

methods.name: setStabilization
methods.signature: setStabilization(id: ClipId, patch: StabilizationPatch | null): Promise<void>
methods.summary: Switch a clip's stabilization on with the changes in `patch` (the others keep the clip's value, or the engine's defaults), or off with null (the settings are kept). Switching on opens the clip on the engine first, which can take seconds, so the call is async and each awaited call is its own undo step. A clip that is already on only stores the changes.
methods.mapsTo: setEnabled / switchOn (src/studio/stabilization/ui/use-stabilization-controls.ts:131) with openStabilization and storeStabilization (src/studio/stabilization/ui/switch.ts)

namespaces.name: titles
namespaces.summary: `studio.titles`: text clips of the active context (design §4.2). Implemented by `createTitlesApi(): TitlesApi` in `namespaces/titles.ts`.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Text clips, top of the stack first. Not an undo step.

methods.name: add
methods.summary: Add a text clip with the editor's default style. One undo step.
methods.example: studio.titles.add({ trackId: 'v1', from: 0, durationInFrames: 90, text: 'Cinque Terre' })

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Change a title's text or style. One undo step.

namespaces.name: effects
namespaces.summary: `studio.effects`: GPU effects on clips (design §4.2). Implemented by `createEffectsApi(): EffectsApi` in `namespaces/effects.ts`.

methods.name: types
methods.summary: Every effect type the editor can apply. Not an undo step.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Effects on a clip, in application order. Not an undo step.

methods.name: add
methods.signature: add(clip: ClipId, type: string, params?: Record<string, EffectParamValue>): EffectId
methods.summary: Add an effect with the type's defaults, plus any `params`. One undo step.

methods.name: update
methods.signature: update(clip: ClipId, effect: EffectId, patch: EffectPatch): void
methods.summary: Change an effect's parameters or enabled flag. One undo step.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Remove an effect from a clip. One undo step.

namespaces.name: keyframes
namespaces.summary: `studio.keyframes`: scalar animation lanes of a clip (design §4.2). Implemented by `createKeyframesApi(): KeyframesApi` in `namespaces/keyframes.ts`. An update that writes nothing adds no undo entry, and `removeAll` clears the clip's vector lanes too.

methods.name: properties
methods.summary: Properties of a clip that can be animated. Not an undo step.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Keyframes of a clip, optionally of one property, in frame order. Not an undo step.

methods.name: add
methods.signature: add(clip: ClipId, property: KeyframeProperty, frame: Frame, value: number, easing?: Easing): KeyframeId
methods.summary: Add a keyframe at a clip-relative frame. One undo step.

methods.name: update
methods.signature: update(clip: ClipId, keyframe: KeyframeId, patch: KeyframePatch): void
methods.summary: Change a keyframe's value, easing or frame. One undo step.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Remove one keyframe. One undo step.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.summary: Remove every keyframe of a clip, or of one property. One undo step.

namespaces.name: transitions
namespaces.summary: `studio.transitions`: transitions at the cuts of the active context (design §4.2). Implemented by `createTransitionsApi(): TransitionsApi` in `namespaces/transitions.ts`.

methods.name: presentations
methods.summary: Presentation ids a transition can use. Not an undo step.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Transitions of the active context. Not an undo step.

methods.name: add
methods.summary: Add a transition at the cut between two adjacent clips. One undo step.

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Change a transition's presentation, length or timing. One undo step. A patch that names no field changes nothing and adds no undo entry.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Remove a transition, leaving the cut. One undo step.

namespaces.name: markers
namespaces.summary: `studio.markers`: markers and the in/out range (design §4.2). Implemented by `createMarkersApi(): MarkersApi` in `namespaces/markers.ts`.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Markers in frame order. Not an undo step.

methods.name: add
methods.summary: Add a marker at a frame. One undo step.
methods.example: const id = studio.markers.add({ frame: 120, label: 'take off' })

methods.name: update
methods.summary: Change a marker's frame, label or colour. One undo step.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Remove one marker. One undo step.

methods.name: clear
methods.summary: Remove every marker of the active context. One undo step.

methods.name: range
methods.summary: The in/out playback range. Not an undo step.

methods.name: setIn
methods.summary: Set the in point, or clear it with null; a point past the end is clamped and one past the out point resets the out point. One undo step.

methods.name: setOut
methods.summary: Set the out point, or clear it with null; a point past the end is clamped and one before the in point resets the in point. One undo step.

methods.name: clearRange
methods.summary: Clear both in and out points. One undo step.

namespaces.name: selection
namespaces.summary: `studio.selection`: what the editor has selected. Not an undo step. Implemented by `createSelectionApi(): SelectionApi` in `namespaces/selection.ts`.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: The current selection. Not an undo step.

methods.name: set
methods.summary: Select clips, tracks, a marker or a transition. Not an undo step.

methods.name: clear
methods.summary: Clear the selection. Not an undo step.

namespaces.name: playback
namespaces.summary: `studio.playback`: the transport. Not an undo step. Implemented by `createPlaybackApi(): PlaybackApi` in `namespaces/playback.ts`.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Playhead, playing state, rate and loop. Not an undo step.

methods.name: seek
methods.summary: Move the playhead to a frame. Not an undo step.

methods.name: play
methods.summary: Start playback at the rate `setRate` chose. Not an undo step.
methods.mapsTo: usePlaybackStore.play, then setPlaybackRate with the previous rate

methods.name: pause
methods.summary: Pause playback. Not an undo step.

methods.name: setRate
methods.summary: Set the playback rate multiplier. Not an undo step.

methods.name: setLoop
methods.summary: Turn looping on or off. Not an undo step.
methods.mapsTo: usePlaybackStore.toggleLoop (set semantics: toggles only when the value differs)

namespaces.name: export
namespaces.summary: `studio.export`: the render queue (design §4.2, §0.5, §4.7). Implemented by `createExportApi(): ExportApi` in `namespaces/export.ts`; the settings half lives in `namespaces/export-settings.ts`.

methods.name: settings
methods.summary: The SDK's export settings. Not an undo step.
methods.mapsTo: the SDK settings store (design §0.3); the export dialog does not read it yet

methods.name: setSettings
methods.summary: Change the SDK's export settings. Not an undo step.
methods.mapsTo: the SDK settings store (design §0.3); the export dialog does not read it yet

methods.name: presets
methods.summary: The export dialog's presets resolved for the open project (Instagram Reel, YouTube 4K, Small file, and Same as source when a video clip is placed): each one's settings and numbers. The desktop's ProRes and 10-bit masters need the native encoder and are not offered here. Not an undo step.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Queue an export and return its job. Not an undo step.

methods.name: jobs
methods.summary: Every job in the queue, oldest first. Not an undo step.

methods.name: status
methods.summary: One job, or null when it does not exist. Not an undo step.

methods.name: wait
methods.summary: Wait for a job to finish and return it; when `timeoutMs` passes first, the job as it is then. Not an undo step.

methods.name: cancel
methods.summary: Cancel a queued or running job. Not an undo step.

namespaces.name: history
namespaces.summary: `studio.history`: the undo history of the active context (design §4.2, §4.4). Implemented by `createHistoryApi(): HistoryApi` in `namespaces/history.ts`.

methods.name: undo
methods.summary: Undo up to `steps` entries and return how many were undone. Not an undo step.

methods.name: redo
methods.summary: Redo up to `steps` entries and return how many were redone. Not an undo step.

methods.name: canUndo
methods.summary: Whether an entry can be undone. Not an undo step.

methods.name: canRedo
methods.summary: Whether an entry can be redone. Not an undo step.

methods.name: undoLabel
methods.summary: Label of the next entry `undo` would revert, or null. Not an undo step.

methods.name: redoLabel
methods.summary: Label of the next entry `redo` would restore, or null. Not an undo step.

methods.name: clear
methods.summary: Drop the history of every editing context. Not an undo step.

methods.name: depth
methods.summary: Number of entries that can be undone. Not an undo step.

namespaces.name: workspace
namespaces.summary: `studio.workspace`: whether the app has a workspace folder to work on. Implemented by `createWorkspaceApi(): WorkspaceApi` in `namespaces/workspace.ts`.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.summary: Whether a workspace folder is open. False while the editor shows its workspace gate, when every call that reads or writes the project would throw. Not an undo step.

namespaces.name: looks
namespaces.summary: `studio.looks`: the workspace's looks library, the `.cube` files a clip can apply (`clips.setLook`). Implemented by `createLooksApi(): LooksApi` in `namespaces/looks.ts`.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: The looks of the library, newest last. Reads the library from the workspace when it has not been read yet. Not an undo step.

methods.name: add
methods.summary: Add a look to the library from the text of a `.cube` file (3D table, 65 points per side at most, input range 0…1) and answer it as `list` does. An agent can write the text with code in the same `run` call (a function over r, g, b) instead of sending a large file. The look is the workspace's, not the project's: not an undo step. `name` is the picker's label (default: the file's TITLE, or its name).
methods.example: await studio.looks.add({ fileName: 'warm.cube', text: cubeText, name: 'Warm' })

namespaces.name: shadow
namespaces.summary: `studio.shadow`: DroneClean shadow removal on a clip. Mark the shadow, follow it (free), read the price, clean at that price (spends credits). Implemented by `createShadowApi(): ShadowApi` in `namespaces/shadow.ts`. An agent cannot sign in: when the service needs it the user approves it in the app.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: A clip's shadow session: the mark, the stage, the ranges found, the price and the last failure. Not an undo step.

methods.name: mark
methods.summary: Mark the shadow on a clip: a point in source pixels on a source frame (default: the frame the playhead shows on the clip). Forgets a pass made for another mark. One undo step.

methods.name: follow
methods.summary: Follow the marked shadow with the free tracking pass and price cleaning what it found. Awaits the whole pass (cut, upload, track, quote) and costs no credits.

methods.name: quote
methods.summary: Ask the price of the found ranges again, which also reads the balance again (after credits were bought). Not an undo step and no credits are spent.

methods.name: clean
methods.summary: Clean the followed ranges. This SPENDS the user's credits: pass the credits you expect to spend, and the call refuses unless that equals the current price (`costCredits` of `shadow.quote`), so a clean never costs more than the price you were shown. The cleaned file is kept in the project and recorded on the clip.

types.name: ClipId
types.declaration: export type ClipId = string;
types.summary: Opaque id of a timeline clip (a `TimelineItem`). Never parse it.

types.name: TrackId
types.declaration: export type TrackId = string;
types.summary: Opaque id of a timeline track (a `TimelineTrack`). Never parse it.

types.name: MediaId
types.declaration: export type MediaId = string;
types.summary: Opaque id of a media library item (`MediaMetadata`). Never parse it.

types.name: EffectId
types.declaration: export type EffectId = string;
types.summary: Opaque id of one effect instance applied to a clip (`ItemEffect`). Never parse it.

types.name: MarkerId
types.declaration: export type MarkerId = string;
types.summary: Opaque id of a timeline marker (`ProjectMarker`). Never parse it.

types.name: TransitionId
types.declaration: export type TransitionId = string;
types.summary: Opaque id of a transition (`Transition`). Never parse it.

types.name: KeyframeId
types.declaration: export type KeyframeId = string;
types.summary: Opaque id of a keyframe (`Keyframe.id`). Never parse it.

types.name: Frame
types.declaration: export type Frame = number;
types.summary: Integer frame on the timeline, counted at the project rate.

types.name: SourceFrame
types.declaration: export type SourceFrame = number;
types.summary: Integer frame inside a source media file, counted at the source rate.

types.name: Seconds
types.declaration: export type Seconds = number;
types.summary: Seconds. Only for values the stores keep in seconds (audio fades, subtitle cues).

types.name: Rate
types.summary: A frame rate as an exact fraction of frames per second (design §4.3): 59.94 is `{ num: 60000, den: 1001 }`, never `{ num: 59.94, den: 1 }`. Both numbers are positive whole numbers; a rate is read back reduced, and `@/studio/time`'s `toRate` and `rateValue` are the only conversions.

types.name: TimelineContext
types.declaration: export type TimelineContext = MainTimelineContext | CompositionTimelineContext;
types.summary: The context the SDK reads and writes: the Main timeline, or the composition that is open for editing in the app (design §4.3). Ids and the undo history belong to one context; an id from another context is `NOT_FOUND`.

types.name: MainTimelineContext
types.summary: The Main timeline is the active context.

types.name: CompositionTimelineContext
types.summary: An open sub-composition is the active context.

types.name: ProjectInfo
types.summary: A project as the SDK reads it (`useProjectStore.currentProject`).

types.name: ProjectCreateInput
types.summary: Input of `project.create` (design §0.6).

types.name: ProjectPatch
types.summary: Fields `project.set` can change.

types.name: MediaType
types.declaration: export type MediaType = 'video' | 'audio' | 'image' | 'lottie' | 'unknown';
types.summary: Kind of a media library item, derived from its MIME type.

types.name: MediaInfo
types.summary: A media library item as the SDK reads it (`MediaMetadata`, `@/types/storage`).

types.name: MediaImportOptions
types.summary: Options of `media.import` (design §2).

types.name: MediaFilter
types.summary: Filter of `media.list`.

types.name: SubclipId
types.declaration: export type SubclipId = string;
types.summary: Id of a subclip.

types.name: SubclipInvalidReason
types.declaration: export type SubclipInvalidReason = 'parent-missing' | 'range-past-end' | 'rate-changed';
types.summary: Why a subclip cannot be used any more: its file is gone from the library, the file has fewer frames than the range needs, or the file's frame rate changed after the range was cut.

types.name: SubclipInfo
types.summary: A subclip as the SDK reads it: a named range of one library file (`Subclip`, `@/studio/subclips`). The range is whole source frames of the file, `[startFrame, endFrame)`, the convention of a clip's `sourceStart` and `sourceEnd`, so it goes into `clips.add` unchanged.

types.name: SubclipCreateInput
types.summary: Input of `subclips.create`.

types.name: SubclipFilter
types.summary: Filter of `subclips.list`.

types.name: TrackKind
types.declaration: export type TrackKind = 'video' | 'audio';
types.summary: A track is either a video or an audio track.

types.name: TrackInfo
types.summary: A track as the SDK reads it (`TimelineTrack` without its item list).

types.name: TrackAddInput
types.summary: Input of `tracks.add`.

types.name: TrackPatch
types.summary: Fields `tracks.update` can change.

types.name: ClipType
types.declaration: export type ClipType = 'video' | 'audio' | 'text' | 'image' | 'lottie' | 'shape' | 'adjustment' | 'controller' | 'composition' | 'subtitle';
types.summary: Kind of a timeline clip (the discriminator of `TimelineItem`).

types.name: ClipTransform
types.summary: Placement and scale of a clip on the canvas (`TransformProperties`).

types.name: ClipInfo
types.summary: A clip as the SDK reads it. Positions and durations are timeline frames; `source*` and `trim*` are source frames (design §4.3). Effects and keyframes are read through `studio.effects` and `studio.keyframes`, not duplicated here.

types.name: ClipAddInput
types.summary: Input of `clips.add` and one entry of `clips.addMany`.

types.name: ClipPatch
types.summary: Fields `clips.update` can change.

types.name: ClipFilter
types.summary: Filter of `clips.list`.

types.name: ClipRemoveOptions
types.summary: Options of `clips.remove`.

types.name: ClipDuplicateOptions
types.summary: Options of `clips.duplicate`.

types.name: SpeedKey
types.summary: One point of a clip's speed curve: a clip-relative timeline frame and the speed there. Frame 0 is the clip's first frame, the origin keyframes use; speeds are 0.1..10.

types.name: ClipSpeedCurve
types.summary: A clip's speed curve, as `clips.getSpeedCurve` reads it (design §4.9 of task 7.1).

types.name: MotionBlurSettings
types.summary: A clip's motion blur, as `clips.getMotionBlur` reads it and `clips.setMotionBlur` takes it (design 7.2, section 4.7).

types.name: SpeedPreset
types.declaration: export type SpeedPreset = 'ramp-in' | 'ramp-out' | 'ramp-in-out';
types.summary: The ramp shapes `clips.setSpeedPreset` builds (design §4.9 of task 7.1).

types.name: SpeedPresetOptions
types.summary: Options of `clips.setSpeedPreset`.

types.name: ColorProfile
types.declaration: export type ColorProfile = 'dlog-m' | 'dlog' | 'none';
types.summary: A clip's colour profile, as `clips.getColorProfile` reads it and `clips.setColorProfile` takes it: DJI D-Log M, DJI D-Log, or `none` (an answered "no transform").

types.name: ClipLookInfo
types.summary: A clip's creative look: a `.cube` file of the workspace's looks library and the blend it is applied with.

types.name: ClipLookRequest
types.summary: What `clips.setLook` takes: the id of a look of the library and, optionally, the blend.

types.name: LookAddInput
types.summary: What `looks.add` takes: a `.cube` file's text and name.

types.name: LookInfo
types.summary: One look of the workspace's looks library, as `looks.list` reads it.

types.name: ClipStabilization
types.summary: A clip's stabilization as it is stored: what the pilot chose; the engine's matrices are not part of it.

types.name: Studio
types.summary: The DroneClean Studio SDK: one typed object over the editor's command store and domain stores (design §4.2). Every call that changes the timeline is one undo step; a failed call leaves the project exactly as it was.

errors.summary: An argument has the wrong type, the wrong shape or a value outside its range; the message names the argument and lists the valid values when they are known.
An id does not exist in the active editing context or in the media library; the message names the argument, the ids that do exist and `studio.project.context()`.
The call is valid on its own but contradicts the project's state: a cut that cannot take a transition, a keyframe inside a transition, a split outside the clip.
The editor cannot do this yet or in this browser: import without file handles, export settings the pipeline does not read, a project stored with an older schema.
A media file's bytes cannot be read: permission denied, the file is gone, or nothing of an import could be read.
An export job failed or was cancelled before it wrote its file.
A store or storage operation failed unexpectedly; the message carries the underlying reason.
